definition.def: You use constant to describe something that happens all the time or is always there.
examples: He has been her constant companion for the last four months.

definition.def: If an amount or level is constant, it stays the same over a particular period of time.
examples: The average speed of the winds remained constant.

definition.def: A constant is a thing or value that always stays the same.
examples: In the world of fashion it sometimes seems that the only constant is ceaseless change.
